content: This product may not necessarily be safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific use. The information provided here is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Precautions: Before using aztreonam, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, or to penicillins, cephalosporins, or other antibiotics such as imipenem or meropenem. Additionally, disclose any other allergies you may have. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Rarely, this medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this dizziness. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are certain you can perform them safely. Limit your consumption of alcoholic beverages. Aztreonam may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. While this drug passes into breast milk, it is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the way your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as specific diabetic urine tests, potentially leading to false results. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: Laboratory and/or medical tests may be conducted while you are using this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Additional Notes: Adding plans allows you to compare formulary status with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current information.
